integration.na: no database, queue or service; installed hook-chain and live BB capability coverage require the host application/provider homes and are recorded separately from checkout-only tests in scripts/verify-suites.json

journeys.na: no user interface or network service; the kit ships instructions, skills and hooks

evals.na: no LLM features in the kit itself

rehearsal.na: no background processing or data migration

mutation.na: no mutation tool is installed for this Python and shell repo; each gate fix carries a focused mutation check in its review

postdeploy.na: nothing is deployed; homes are installed locally by each skillset's install script
